note: Jerauld County publishes its zoning as a PDF Zoning Book (linked from jerauldcountysd.com/equalization). Its GIS mapping viewer (gis.districtiii.org/jerauld) has moved and is unsupported in the browser; no ArcGIS REST service, zoning layer, or open-data item for Jerauld County was found.
